The '''2022 Ryloth Regionals''' were held on 6 March 2022 at De Vos en de Craen in Tilburg, Netherlands, run by [[Tom Damen]], [[Erik Spijksma|Eric Spijksma]] and [[Floris de Vries]]. Ten players played six Swiss games. [[Stephan de Vos|Stephan "Fox"]] won, going 6–0.<ref name="ryl22">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=80189 Ryloth Regionals - Sunday March 6 2022 - Tilburg, The Netherlands], forum.starwarsccg.org (9 February – 10 March 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105004515/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t80189.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]] (all Virtual cards)<ref name="ryl22" />
* '''Site:''' De Vos en de Craen, Piusplein 2, Tilburg<ref name="ryl22" />
* '''Date:''' 6 March 2022<ref name="ryl22" />
* '''Structure:''' 6 games Swiss (SoS)<ref name="ryl22" />
* '''Tournament directors:''' [[Tom Damen]], [[Erik Spijksma|Eric Spijksma]], [[Floris de Vries]]<ref name="ryl22" />
* '''Field:''' 10 players<ref name="ryl22" />

The Dark Side decks were Shadow Collective (2), Agents Of Black Sun (2), BHBM, Verge, ISB, Walkers, Invasion and Hunt Down (V); the Light Side decks were Yoda communing, Funeral Pyre LTWWv, Slave Quarters LTWWv, EBO fakeout, Hyperdrive (V), No Idea, Old Allies (2), Watch Your Step and HITCO.<ref name="ryl22" />
